creator.description:
This is just to be able to connect our comunity together and keep the haters at bay.
Feel free to add any of this label.

locales.description: A person who is uncertain about their sexual orientation and/or gender identity; this can be a transitory or a lasting identity.
locales.name: Questioning

locales.description: A person whose choice of sexual or romantic partner is not limited by the other person's sex, gender identity or gender expression.
locales.name: Pansexual

locales.description: Referring to a person whose gender identity does not align with a binary understanding of gender such as man or woman. It is a gender identity which may include man and woman, androgynous, fluid, multiple, no gender, or a different gender outside of the “woman—man” spectrum.
locales.name: Non-Binary (also ‘Genderqueer’)

locales.description: A person whose gender identity varies over time and may include male, female and non-binary gender identities.
locales.name: Gender-fluid

locales.description: A person who lacks sexual attraction or interest in sexual expression. An asexual person’s sexual and romantic orientations may differ (e.g. biromantic asexual), and they may have sexual and/or romantic partners.
locales.name: Asexual

locales.description: A person who lacks romantic attraction or interest in romantic expression. An aromantic person’s sexual and romantic orientations may differ (e.g. aromantic lesbian), and they may have romantic and/or sexual partners.
locales.name: Aromantic

locales.description: An umbrella term to capture various types of biological sex differentiation. Intersex people have variations in their sex characteristics, such as sex chromosomes, internal reproductive organs, genitalia, and/or secondary sex characteristics (e.g. muscle mass, breasts) that fall outside of what is typically categorized as male or female..
locales.name: Intersex

locales.description: Historically a derogatory term used as a slur against 2SLGBTQI+ people, this term has been reclaimed by many 2SLGBTQI+ people as a positive way to describe themselves, and as a way to include the many diverse identities not covered by common 2SLGBTQI+ acronym..
locales.name: Queer

locales.description: A person whose gender identity differs from what is typically associated with the sex they were assigned at birth..
locales.name: Transgender (also ‘Trans’)

locales.description: A person who is sexually and/or romantically attracted to two or more genders.
locales.name: Bisexual or Biromantic

locales.description: Typically a man who is sexually and/or romantically attracted to other men.
locales.name: Gay

locales.description: Typically a woman who is sexually and/or romantically attracted to other women.
locales.name: Lesbian

locales.description: Publication en liens avec une personne  Deux-Esprits.
locales.name: Deux-Esprit

locales.description: Publication en liens avec la communauté 2SLGBTQI+.
locales.name: 2SLGBTQI+
